metadata.name: governance
metadata.description: Governance program for P2P Energy Trading - Engineering Department administration

accounts.name: new_authority
docs: The proposed new authority who must sign to approve

accounts.name: meter_account
docs: Voter's meter account to determine voting weight.
Bound to the registry program so a forged account with an inflated total_generation
cannot manufacture voting weight (handler still checks meter.owner == voter).

accounts.name: meter_account
docs: We need to verify that the proposer has a registered meter in the target zone.
Bound to the registry program so a forged/attacker-owned account cannot stand in
for a real meter (handler still checks meter.owner == proposer).

accounts.name: governance_config
docs: Governance config - needed for quorum threshold

instructions.name: init_rec_mint
docs: Initialize the fungible REC mint (1 token = 1 MWh, 6 decimals). Run once.

accounts.name: rec_mint
docs: Fungible REC mint: 1 token = 1 MWh, 6 decimals (base unit = 1 Wh; 1 kWh = 1000 units).
Mint authority = governance_config PDA `[b"governance_config"]`.

accounts.name: meter_account
docs: Meter account from registry program - stricter validation via owner constraint

accounts.name: owner

accounts.name: registry

accounts.name: registry_program

accounts.name: rec_mint
docs: Fungible REC mint (1 token = 1 MWh, 6 decimals). Created by `init_rec_mint`.

accounts.name: rec_token_account

REC tokens are minted here on issuance.

instructions.name: retire_rec

accounts.name: holder
docs: Holder retiring (burning) their REC tokens to claim the green attribute.

accounts.name: current_owner

types.name: AggregatorEntry
docs: PoA-admitted aggregator (off-chain validator node) allow-list entry.
One PDA per aggregator pubkey — `seeds = [b"aggregator", aggregator.as_ref()]` — so admission
scales without a growing `Vec` in a global account (Sealevel per-entity-PDA rule). Other
programs (e.g. `oracle`) authorize an aggregator by deriving this PDA for the signer, checking
it is owned by the governance program, and requiring `active == true`.

fields.name: aggregator
docs: The admitted aggregator's signing pubkey.

fields.name: admitted_at
docs: When the entry was admitted (unix seconds).

fields.name: updated_at
docs: When the entry was last revoked/re-admitted (unix seconds).

fields.name: active
docs: True while the aggregator is permitted to act; false once revoked.

fields.name: bump
docs: Canonical PDA bump.

fields.name: segment
docs: Market segment this aggregator is admitted to operate in (role-map.md fix #6):
0 = Retail (MEA/PEA), 1 = Wholesale (EGAT). Appended at the end so existing raw-byte
readers (registry's `register_validator`, trading's `require_admitted_aggregator`),
which only read `[8..40)` and `[56]`, are unaffected by the size change.
